title: Blockade of GPX4-mediated ferroptosis underlies the protective effect of Forsythiae Fructus water extract against poly(I:C)-induced inflammation.
authors: Guo, Xindeng; Chen, Bing; Su, Zhixian; Cao, Xia; Dai, Lingna; Lu, Zibin; Liang, Zhiqing; Jiang, Li; Cao, Huihui; Chen, Xiangdong; Hu, Yunguang; Yu, Linzhong; Lu, Hua; Liu, Junshan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药连翘水提物通过GPX4抑制铁死亡缓解炎症，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Forsythiae Fructus is a widely used traditional Chinese medicine commonly employed in the treatment of inflammation-related diseases. However, its underlying anti-inflammatory mechanisms remain incompletely elucidated. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic effects of Forsythiae Fructus water extract (LQKL) against poly(I:C)-induced inflammation and to explore whether it acts by inhibiting ferroptosis. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The protective effects of LQKL were evaluated using poly(I:C)-induced inflammatory models in both RAW264.7 cells and zebrafish. Potential targets and pathways of LQKL against poly(I:C)-induced inflammation were initially predicted by network pharmacology analysis and subsequently validated through RT-qPCR, Western blot, immunofluorescence, siRNA transfection, and CRISPRi. Lipid peroxidation levels were assessed by measuring MDA content and ROS production using colorimetric assay and fluorescence microscopy, respectively. Furthermore, the key anti-inflammatory components in LQKL were identified through integrated approaches including molecular docking, DARTS, and CETSA assays. RESULTS: LQKL significantly attenuated poly(I:C)-induced inflammation in zebrafish, as evidenced by reduced neutrophil and macrophage infiltration and improved survival rate. It also downregulated the expressions of IL-6 and TNF-alpha in both poly(I:C)-stimulated zebrafish and RAW264.7 cells. Network pharmacology analysis indicated that LQKL may act through inhibition of the NF-kappaB signaling pathway which were verified by the decrease of p-NF-kappaB p65 and p-IkappaBalpha, as well as the nuclear translocation of NF-kappaB p65. Moreover, LQKL inhibited MDA content, suppressed the generation of ROS, restored GSH content and regulated the expressions of proteins related to ferroptosis. Notably, GPX4 knockdown markedly diminished the anti-inflammatory effects of LQKL and its suppression of the NF-kappaB pathway. Furthermore, wogonin was identified as a key active component in LQKL that strongly binds to GPX4. CONCLUSION: LQKL alleviates poly(I:C)-induced inflammation by attenuating ferroptosis through GPX4 activation, leading to subsequent inhibition of the NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：连翘（Forsythiae Fructus）是一种广泛使用的传统中药，常用于治疗炎症相关疾病。然而，其潜在的抗炎机制尚未完全阐明。研究目的：本研究旨在评估连翘水提取物（LQKL）对poly(I:C)诱导炎症的治疗效果，并探讨其是否通过抑制铁死亡（ferroptosis）发挥作用。材料与方法：使用RAW264.7细胞和斑马鱼中的poly(I:C)诱导炎症模型评估LQKL的保护作用。通过网络药理学分析初步预测LQKL对抗poly(I:C)诱导炎症的潜在靶点和通路，并通过RT-qPCR、Western blot、免疫荧光、siRNA转染和CRISPRi进行验证。通过比色法和荧光显微镜分别测量MDA含量和ROS产生来评估脂质过氧化水平。此外，通过整合分子对接（molecular docking）、DARTS和CETSA分析等方法鉴定LQKL中的关键抗炎成分。结果：LQKL显著减轻了斑马鱼中poly(I:C)诱导的炎症，表现为中性粒细胞和巨噬细胞浸润减少以及存活率提高。它还下调了poly(I:C)刺激的斑马鱼和RAW264.7细胞中IL-6和TNF-α的表达。网络药理学分析表明，LQKL可能通过抑制NF-κB信号通路发挥作用，这通过p-NF-κB p65和p-IκBα的减少以及NF-κB p65的核转位得到验证。此外，LQKL抑制了MDA含量，抑制了ROS的产生，恢复了GSH含量，并调节了与铁死亡相关蛋白的表达。值得注意的是，GPX4敲低显著减弱了LQKL的抗炎效果及其对NF-κB通路的抑制。进一步地，木犀草素（wogonin）被鉴定为LQKL中与GPX4强结合的关键活性成分。结论：LQKL通过GPX4激活减轻铁死亡，从而缓解poly(I:C)诱导的炎症，并随后抑制NF-κB通路。
